title: Game Development with SDL 2.0 (Steam Dev Days 2014)
summary: Ryan Gordon (Icculus) gives a high-level overview of SDL 2.0 at Steam Dev Days 2014. He covers its features and how it eases building, porting and maintaining games, including Linux ports.
why: HN commenters link it when people ask about cross-platform game development and for details like SDL's licensing change.

quote.text: Here's a talk he did about porting games to Linux with SDL 2.0 during a Steam Dev Days event
